sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months. Specific disease 24 months. 30-day initial waiting (except accident). Maternity and New Born are optional with own waiting. Domiciliary requires 3 consecutive days of treatment.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Annual Sum Insured plus Gullak (Guaranteed Cumulative Bonus); covers room rent, ICU, surgeon, anaesthesia, drugs, diagnostics, prosthetic devices, artificial life maintenance subject to terms
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room category capped at Single Private AC Room unless specified; proportionate share if higher room availed

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Day care treatments / surgeries <24 hours covered

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Requires minimum 3 consecutive days of treatment; excludes Asthma/COPD/Arthritis/Chronic Nephritis/Diarrhoea/Diabetes/Epilepsy/Hypertension/PUO

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for AYUSH Treatment at AYUSH Hospital or Day Care Centre
ayush_coverage.notes: Excludes facilities for pleasure/rejuvenation, Panchakarma for non-treatment purposes

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Maternity and New Born Hospitalization Expenses available as optional cover

newborn_coverage.limit_text: New Born Baby Hospitalization Expenses (optional, linked to Maternity)

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Donor in-patient + pre/post-hospitalisation (up to 30 days) + screening costs + post-harvest complications (up to 30 days from discharge), all up to Sum Insured
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Per Transplantation of Human Organs Act, 1994

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road Ambulance — reasonable and customary expenses up to per-hospitalisation limit specified in Policy Schedule
ambulance_cover.notes: Air Ambulance available as optional cover

critical_illness_cover.notes: May be available as add-on (not in brochure key highlights)

restoration_benefit.limit_text: 100% restoration of Sum Insured any number of times in a Policy Year (same or unrelated illness/injury)

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Health Check-up + Wellness Program + Discount from Network Providers

room_rent_capping: Single Private AC Room (default); proportionate reduction if higher room availed
icu_capping: No cap (covered up to Sum Insured)
copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary Co-Payment optional for premium discount

disease_wise_sub_limits.modern_treatments: Up to Sum Insured for listed advanced procedures (Uterine Artery Embolisation, Balloon Sinuplasty, Deep Brain Stimulation, Oral Chemotherapy, Immunotherapy, Intra Vitreal injections, Robotic surgery, Stereotactic radiosurgery, Bronchial Thermoplasty, Prostate vaporisation, IONM, Hematopoietic Stem Cell therapy)

notable_exclusions_summary: Premium HNI-grade indemnity plan covering up to Rs.10 crore SI. Unlimited restoration of SI per year (same or unrelated illness). HIV and Mental Illness covered up to SI. Maternity, New Born, Air Ambulance, Personal Accident, Voluntary Co-pay, Room Modifier, Deductible (aggregate/daily), Coverage for Non-Medical Items (Shakti/Anant) optional. Standard IRDAI permanent exclusions plus pleasure-based AYUSH facility exclusions.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via ManipalCigna empanelled network and TPA; Tele-consultation, Wellness Program and Discount from Network Providers as value-added services.
available_riders: Maternity and New Born Hospitalization Expenses
Room Rent Modification (Any Room / Twin Sharing AC Room)
